caseName: Caplin v. Marine Midland Grace Trust Co.
caseNameFull: Caplin, Trustee v. Marine Midland Grace Trust Co. of New York

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 404 U. S. 982.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument on behalf of the Securities and Exchange Commission granted and a total of 15 minutes allotted for that purpose. Counsel for respondent allotted 15 additional minutes for oral argument.
